about: Published API prices, for cost projections (and for real adapters when they're added). Micro-USD per million tokens. Cache prices are for the 5-minute cache. An openai-compat/<host>/<model> entry carries its own source and date, how its answer is asked for (answer: tools, json or text), context_tokens (its context window, checked before every call) and concurrency_cost (its share of the host's concurrent units) where the host gives them, reasoning_tokens (a model that reasons in its output: room for that, added to every call's own room, participants/src/llm/call.ts) and max_output_tokens (the most a host gives a call: a call made again with more room is never given more) where set, and to_confirm while its price is unverified: a price to confirm is never used to run (docs/real-models.md, "Hosted open-weight models").

claude-code/claude-haiku-5-5.source: Not a published price: what Claude Code (claude -p) itself reckons a call of Haiku 5.5 at (its total_cost_usd and modelUsage costUSD), which the adapter charges where it is more than the API price (orchestrator/src/experiment-seats.ts, priceOf). Fitted exactly (to the cent) to 16 calls on 2026-11-11 (docs/decisions.md, "What a claude -p seat call costs"): $5 a million in, $6.25 written to the cache (Claude Code writes an hour's cache, reckoned at 1.25 times), $0.50 read, $25 out.

openai-compat/openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3.source: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (the model's pricing.prompt and .completion, USD per token, times a million; context_length). OpenRouter sends a call to one of several providers at their own prices and precisions; the reply's own cost is recorded and the greater charged Reasoning: reasoning_tokens is our own allowance for the model's thinking, added to every call's room for the answer and sent as OpenRouter's reasoning.max_tokens (https://openrouter.ai/docs/use-cases/reasoning-tokens, read 2026-11-16: reasoning and the answer share max_tokens, and a reply whose reasoning uses the whole room comes back with no message, its reasoning still billed; the model lists reasoning among its supported_parameters); 16,000 because in the probes of 2026-11-16 (runs scope-stakes-r1-decision-slow-situation-glm-5.3-b and -deepseek-v4.1-flash-b) 10 of GLM's 61 and 11 of DeepSeek's 101 seat calls spent all of an 8,000-token room reasoning and said nothing; a guess, to be set from the reasoning tokens the next runs record. max_output_tokens: top_provider.max_completion_tokens on the same page, read 2026-11-16
